about.shortDescriptor: Read together. Exchange languages and ideas.
about.introP1: Japanese Reading Club (JPR Club) began in Jordan on September 11, 2024, as an independent initiative by Japanese-language learners. Its starting idea was simple: make reading an enjoyable way to develop language skills and understand texts, without the pressure of traditional study.
about.introP2: Today, the club brings together Japanese learners and people who enjoy reading, and welcomes Japanese participants interested in language and cultural exchange. Japanese is our starting point, and we also read and discuss material in Arabic and English through in-person and online sessions.

whatWeDo.title: What happens here
whatWeDo.card1Desc: We select material suited to participants—from graded readers and manga to short stories, novels, and news—and explore its meaning, vocabulary, and language points together.
whatWeDo.card2Desc: We ask questions, share impressions, and explore different perspectives in a supportive setting. You do not need to understand every word before joining a discussion.
whatWeDo.card3Desc: Our Reading Studio brings together session summaries, photographs, and notes so participants can revisit what we explored and keep learning.

principles.title: What guides us
principles.item1: Small, consistent steps can create a larger impact.
principles.item2: Asking questions and participating open possibilities for learning and connection.
principles.item3: Ideas do not need to be perfect before being shared; they improve through experience and feedback.
